text:
lina: Heads up — noticed a customer billing spike tied to streaming + toolcall retries. Looks like truncated tool response then client reconnect -> double token charge.
kevin: Ugh. Can you paste the logs + request ids?
lina: yup. Root request id: r-0a1b2c3d4e. client session s-77. snippet: 
```
IN: stream-start id=r-0a1b2c3d4e model=redwood-3 length=4096
OUT: toolcall id=t-999 partial=true tokens=120
RETRY: reconnect session=s-77 resume=true
OUT: toolcall id=t-999 tokens=320
```
sam: So the first toolcall was marked partial (truncated) but got credited 120 tokens. After reconnect we re-ran the toolcall and billed 320 more?
maria: Do we have the ledger entries for r-0a1b2c3d4e?
lina: ledger shows two separate charges: charge-112233 (120 tokens) and charge-112244 (320 tokens). Both tied to r-0a1b2c3d4e but different internal path ids.
kevin: Are toolcall IDs stable across retries? If t-999 is same, can we dedupe by toolcall id + session?
sam: Not always — some internal proxy reassigns toolcall ids on reconnect. We have a short-term idempotency token but it's request-scoped and lost on reconnect.
maria: Is the truncation flag set by the runtime or by the tool backend? Important to know who owns the truth.
lina: runtime sets partial=true when stream was cut (EOF) before tool signalled complete. tool backend confirms it returned an incomplete payload and we asked client to reconnect.
kevin: Hypothesis: on resume we treat toolcall as new (new id), so ledger credits both. Proposal: extend the provisional window and bind provisional credits to a session-stable resume_token instead of transient toolcall id.
sam: Could we instead make the console show provisional vs confirmed charges per-route? Ops can then see provisional charges that got confirmed later and avoid surprise.
maria: UX wise, adding a per-request resume_token column in billing table helps debugging. But backend change needed first.
kevin: Implementation outline: 1) emit resume_token on initial partial toolcall; 2) ledger attaches provisional credit to resume_token; 3) on successful resume/confirm, consolidate credits into one confirmed charge (dedupe within 10m).
ops-bot: deploy-preview: patch/ledger-resume-token created by kevin — CI tests passing.
lina: Nice. Edgecases: what if client abandons and we should refund provisional? We need a TTL and garbage collection that flips provisional->stale then report to billing ops.
sam: And metric: count of provisional credits per hour + fraction confirmed. Dashboard idea under "Billing -> Provisional Credits" with per-route filter.
maria: Also need to consider streaming responders with toolcall chaining (tool A calls tool B) — resume_token must be propagated or mapped.
kevin: Agreed. I'll draft an RFC with APIs: resume_token lifecycle, ledger schema change (provisional flag, resume_token field), 10m dedupe window, GC TTL of 24h for stale provisional.
lina: For immediate mitigation — add a console banner and a manual refund support flow for affected customers.
sam: Can we add a quick alert rule: spike in provisional credits > 100 in 5m for a customer triggers ops-notify?
kevin: I'll open a follow-up thread with concrete DB migration plan.
maria: Thanks — that should be enough to start. :thumbsup:
